name: Belt of the Snake King
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 260, Pathfinder #42: Sanctum of the Serpent God pg. 28, Gods and Magic pg. 54
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 260, Pathfinder #42: Sanctum of the Serpent God pg. 28, Gods and Magic pg. 54
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th
Slot belt; Price 2,600 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This belt writhes like a living snake, and even hisses and blinks its red eyes. It clasps by holding its tail in its mouth. The wearer gains a +1 enhancement bonus to natural armor.

If the serpentfolk god Ydersius is the wearer’s patron, once per day, the wearer can use magic fang on one of his own natural weapons.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, magic fang, summon monster I; Cost 1,300 gp
